blocks.html: As part of its Holiday traditions, Robinsons Malls Giant Christmas Trees take center stage as the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony mark the beginning of the Yuletide celebrations. Decked with larger-than-life snowflakes, glittery Christmas balls, and elaborate arrangements in champagne gold and silver, the 40-foot-tall Christmas tree at Robinsons Place Manila shined the brightest in the night bringing joy to every mall-goer. Hanging on the giant Christmas tree are lighted windows which beautifully change into festive colors. At the center of it all are life-sized children carolers holding musical instruments, imbibing a cheerful holiday spirit. President-Mayor Joseph Ejercito Estrada led the lighting ceremony together with (L-R) Kapamilya singer and actor, Matteo Guidicelli; Irving Wu, RLC’s Operations Director for Luzon; Ditas Taleon, VP for Lease; Hon. Maria Sheilah Lacuna-Pangan, Vice-Mayor of Manila City; and Mark Louie Sta. Ana, Regional Operations Manager.
